messages:
Maya: Quick reminder — release cutoff in ~6 hours. If your PR needs a changelog entry, please add one now or mark it `no-changelog` and leave a short justification.

Maya: Use the standard entry shape: type, scope (optional), short summary, optional details. See CONTRIBUTING > release-notes.

TJ: Quick Q — is 'fix: improve retry backoff' a 'bug' or 'chore'?

Olivia: @TJ bug (it fixes observable incorrect behavior)

Dena: Also please set `changelog/author` label to whoever wrote the PR if it's not obvious. Helps me rollups. :pray:

Maya: If you're unsure, default to 'bug' for bugfixes, 'improvement' for perf/quality changes, 'docs' for doc-only.

Sam: pinging CI — I added a tiny formatting check in the release pipeline, it runs `./scripts/changelog-lint --staged` on merge. If it fails, it blocks the release entry.

release-bot: [automated] changelog-lint will run on merged PRs from now until cutoff. See #eng-releases for failures.

TJ: Got a lint fail on #4821 — says 'missing type field'. The PR description includes a section but not the exact YAML frontmatter.

Olivia: Can paste the minimal shape here — it's tiny:```
---
type: bug
scope: runtime
summary: Fix NPE in cache eviction
details: Fixes crash when kv-cache is empty at startup
---
```

Dena: If you want a one-line quickcopy, use:
`type: bug
summary: ...`

Maya: Also a reminder to bump the package version in `pkg/version/version.go` for any non-doc changes that affect consumers. If you can't bump, flag it and @Maya will coordinate.

TJ: Quick one — backports: should they get their own changelog entries or be rolled into the main PR?

Dena: Backports need entries too, but prefix with `(backport)` in the summary so the release notes script groups them.

Sam: FYI I unlocked a tiny exception for meta-only PRs to skip lint if they contain `no-changelog` and the author explains in the PR body. Try to avoid abusing it.

Maya: Thanks everyone. If you see any failing lint output, paste it here or DM me. I'll do a final sweep 30 min before cutoff. :hourglass: 

Olivia: done, added missing frontmatter to #4821 and re-requested review.

TJ: I marked #4833 as `no-changelog` with rationale (docs only, internal links).

Maya: Perfect — appreciate the quick turn.

release-bot: [automated] changelog-lint passed on branch 'main' at 1790004000.
